subject: Post-demo: deployment heatmap & migration matrix — next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@medsure.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: deployment heatmap & migration matrix — next steps

Hi Sofia / team,

Thanks again for the demo call this morning. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we stay aligned:

- Goal: Move from a mix of OpenAI-hosted endpoints + on-prem GPU cluster to a predictable inference platform for production ML features.
- Deployment preferences you mentioned: pilot on Hosted API, production on Dedicated GPU pools, regulated PII pipelines potentially on Private VPC/on-prem.
- Key unknowns we need to size: steady-state QPS, 95th pct latency target (ms), percent of requests that touch PII, and expected peak concurrency during batch jobs (nightly retrains / re-embeds).

Action items (proposed):
1) Please confirm hosting preference per environment (dev/staging/prod) and attach a brief traffic profile (CSV or a bullet list).
2) Schedule a 60-min technical deep dive with your infra lead (we want to validate network egress, VPC peering, and KMS/HSM needs).
3) We will produce a lightweight deployment heatmap + migration matrix that outlines tradeoffs (lift effort, timeline, cost delta) across Hosted / Dedicated / Private.

Attachments included: redwood-hosting-comparison.xlsx (starter), SOW_v1.pdf (draft pricing bands — see section 2).

Proposed tech-call windows: Wed 5/5 10:00–11:00 PDT, Thu 5/6 09:00–10:00 PDT, or Fri 5/7 14:00–15:00 PDT. Let me know what works.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0198

On Mon, 3 May 2027 at 09:15, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo call this morning. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we stay aligned:
> ...

Thanks Jordan — great summary.

Short answers:
- Preferred split: Dev & prototypes -> Hosted API; Production customer-facing endpoints -> Dedicated capacity (isolation + predictable latency); Regulated PII workflows -> Private VPC (we have strict SOC2 + local country data residency reqs).
- Current setup: mix of OpenAI-hosted APIs for exploratory features + an on-prem Kubernetes cluster with NVIDIA A100s for heavy batches and internal models.
- Traffic profile (rough): steady-state 80 QPS across low-latency endpoints, 95th-pct latency target 150 ms, ~12% requests contain PII, nightly batch re-embed jobs that spike to 200 concurrent batch workers.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll loop in Ved Patel (infra lead) to schedule the technical deep-dive — cc'ing him now.
- Please send an estimate for the Dedicated configuration and a checkbox list of what you'd need for Private VPC (peering, routable ranges, certs, KMS).

Sofia Ramos
Head of Product
Medsure Health
sofia.ramos@medsure.com
